records.title: DocSLM: A Small Vision-Language Model for Long Multimodal Document Understanding
records.reason: DocSLM compresses each document page into a fixed-length multimodal sequence via a Hierarchical Multimodal Compressor, reporting 82% fewer visual tokens, 75% fewer parameters and 71% lower latency for long-document VLM inference on memory-constrained edge devices.

records.title: TWIST & SCOUT: Grounding Multimodal LLM-Experts by Forget-Free Tuning
records.reason: TWIST is a twin-expert tuning module and SCOUT a synthetic dataset that teach pre-trained MLLMs visual grounding without forgetting; the contribution is capability training for grounding, with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: Optimizing Privacy-Preserving Primitives to Support LLM-Scale Applications
records.reason: Overview of hardware/software/algorithm co-design for MPC, zero-knowledge proofs and FHE at LLM scale; transformer inference under privacy primitives is only one of several contexts (DNN IP ownership, usage enforcement, private learning), and the paper is a progress overview rather than an inference system.

records.title: The Impact of Decorrelation on Transformer Interpretation Methods: Applications to Clinical Speech AI
records.reason: Studies how two decorrelation methods change Comprehensiveness and Sufficiency interpretation metrics for a BERT model in clinical speech AI; an interpretability analysis with no inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Ghost in the Transformer: Tracing LLM Lineage with SVD-Fingerprint
records.reason: GhostSpec builds SVD fingerprints from invariant products of attention weight matrices to trace LLM lineage and protect IP; model provenance verification, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: What Makes Two Language Models Think Alike?
records.reason: Maps activations of 43 language models onto interpretable linguistic features to explain representational similarity across model families; a scientific analysis paper with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Evaluating Expert Contributions in a MoE LLM for Quiz-Based Tasks
records.reason: Post-hoc evaluation of expert activation patterns and gating distributions in an MoE LLM on the MMLU quiz benchmark; capability/analysis of MoE behavior only, with no system contribution.

records.title: Revisiting Reset Mechanisms in Spiking Neural Networks for Sequential Modeling: Specialized Discretization for Binary Activated RNN
records.reason: Re-examines reset mechanisms and refractory periods in spiking neural networks viewed as binary-activated RNNs for sequential modeling; SNN theory outside LLM inference systems.

records.title: DSFT: Inspiring Diffusion Large Language Models to Comprehend Mathematical and Logical Patterns
records.reason: DSFT adjusts masking strategy and loss to teach diffusion LLMs mathematical and logical patterns, validated as a training/SFT recipe on LLaDA and Dream; training for capability, not inference.

records.title: Small Language Models using Spiking Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Review
records.reason: Comprehensive review of spiking-neural-network small language models (SpikeGPT, BrainGPT, conversion frameworks) for energy-efficient edge NLP; relevant to efficient inference but a survey with no new mechanism.

records.title: ContaGPT: A Domain-Adapted LLM for Romanian Financial and Accounting Applications
records.reason: ContaGPT is a Phi-4 model QLoRA fine-tuned on Romanian fiscal and ERP documents with a BM25/embedding RAG pipeline for financial and accounting queries; a domain-adapted application model.

records.title: Deep Learning and Computer Vision-Based System for Detecting and Separating Abnormal Bags in Automatic Bagging Machines
records.reason: Lightweight ResNet with ghost convolution and distillation that detects and separates abnormal bags inside automatic bagging machines; an industrial computer-vision quality-control application.

records.title: Agentic Neural Networks: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation
records.reason: Agentic Neural Networks organize LLM agent teams as neural-network-like layers and optimize them by textual backpropagation; a multi-agent orchestration framework, not an inference serving or execution system.

records.title: MLVTG: Mamba-Based Feature Alignment and LLM-Driven Purification for Multi-Modal Video Temporal Grounding
records.reason: MLVTG combines a Vision Mamba backbone (MambaAligner) with frozen LLM layers (LLMRefiner) to localize video clips for natural-language queries on QVHighlights/Charades-STA; a video temporal grounding task model.

records.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Effectively Generate Visual Data for Canine Musculoskeletal Diagnoses
records.reason: Investigates whether LLMs can generate synthetic visual training data (colored strokes on a dog body map over 200 muscle/joint regions) for canine musculoskeletal diagnosis; a veterinary data-generation application.

records.title: Maple: A Multi-agent System for Portable Deep Learning across Clusters
records.reason: Maple is a four-agent system that generates correct deep-learning training command lines for heterogeneous GPU clusters and SLURM/PBS schedulers; training-workflow tooling, not inference.

records.title: LLM2IR: simple unsupervised contrastive learning makes long-context LLM great retriever
records.reason: LLM2IR uses unsupervised contrastive learning to convert decoder-only LLMs into dense retrievers evaluated on LoCo/BEIR; a training method for retrieval capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation
records.reason: xMemory decouples agent interaction history into memory components and aggregates them into a revisable hierarchy for retrieval; it is an agent-memory organization scheme whose inference-system contribution (context retrieval cost/quality) is indirect.

records.title: Supercharging Packet-level Network Simulation of Large Model Training via Memoization and Fast-Forwarding
records.reason: Wormhole accelerates packet-level discrete-event network simulation of large-model training via state memoization and steady-state fast-forwarding; a training-network simulator, adjacent to but not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: From Saliency to Discriminability: Rank-Preserving Visual Token Pruning for VLM Rerankers
records.reason: RaDiCal is a training-free visual token pruning framework for VLM listwise rerankers that fuses attention-entropy-calibrated saliency with a rank-discriminative prior, matching dense MRR@10 at a 20% visual token budget.

records.title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Intelligent IT Operations: An AOI System with Context-Aware Compression and Dynamic Task Scheduling
records.reason: AOI is a multi-agent framework for autonomous IT operations whose LLM context compression (72.4% smaller operational context) and dynamic scheduling serve incident-response task success; the systems techniques are embedded in an AIOps application.

records.title: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search by Recycling Zero-Variance Queries During Training
records.reason: Recycles zero-variance GRPO rollout groups back into a mutable pool during RL training of LLM search agents; an RL training-efficiency method, not inference.

records.title: On the Invariants of Softmax Attention
records.reason: Defines the energy field of softmax attention and proves mechanism-level invariants (per-row zero-sum, head-dimension rank bound) plus key incoherence; theoretical/interpretability analysis without a deployable inference mechanism.

records.title: ActiFormer: Sign-Aware Linear Attention for Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition
records.reason: ActiFormer is a sign-aware linear attention architecture tailored to sensor-based human activity recognition on resource-limited devices; a HAR task model, not LLM inference.

records.title: d-HNSW: A High-performance Vector Search Engine on Disaggregated Memory
records.reason: d-HNSW is an RDMA-based HNSW vector search engine co-designed for disaggregated memory pools; it is retrieval infrastructure used by LLM applications rather than LLM inference itself.

records.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention
records.reason: Decomposes the QK^T interaction matrix of 1776 heads into skew-symmetric routing and symmetric filtering parts and studies a diagnostic S-D parameterization; mechanistic analysis of attention, not an inference system.

records.title: MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair
records.reason: MemScope evolves deployed agent memory architectures through evidence-grounded localized code repair by a patch agent; a self-improving agent framework, not inference execution.

records.title: CLIMP: Contrastive Language-Image Mamba Pretraining
records.reason: CLIMP replaces both CLIP encoders with Mamba, reporting 5x less memory and 1.8x fewer FLOPs at high resolution, but the contribution is a contrastive vision-language pretraining model for retrieval/robustness rather than an inference system.

records.title: Ternary Mamba: Grouped Quantization-Aware Training of W1.58A16 State Space Models
records.reason: Ternary Mamba applies grouped quantization-aware training with distillation from a frozen FP16 teacher to compress Mamba-2 1.3B by 3.61x (2,687 to 744 MB) for edge deployment of state-space models.

records.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
records.reason: Selective Regenerative Decoding routes each sampled trajectory to discard, keep, or regenerate only its degraded suffix, provably improving sample efficiency 1.28-1.36x over rejection sampling and matching Best-of-N with substantially fewer generated tokens.

records.title: MUSE: Parallel Multi-Scale Attention for Sequence to Sequence Learning
records.reason: MUSE is a 2019 parallel multi-scale attention architecture for sequence-to-sequence machine translation; a task architecture for MT, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: PICASSO: Unleashing the Potential of GPU-centric Training for Wide-and-deep Recommender Systems
records.reason: PICASSO restructures GPU-centric training of wide-and-deep recommender systems to fix GPU underutilization from fragmented embedding operations; a training system for recommenders.

records.title: Pre-training Multi-task Contrastive Learning Models for Scientific Literature Understanding
records.reason: SciMult is a multi-task contrastive pretraining framework (with an MoE transformer variant) for scientific literature understanding tasks such as citation prediction; pretraining methodology.

records.title: Window Attention is Bugged: How not to Interpolate Position Embeddings
records.reason: Identifies that interpolating position embeddings under window attention is a bug in Hiera/ViTDet and fixes it with absolute window position embeddings for COCO detection; a vision-model correctness fix.

records.title: ∞-Video: A Training-Free Approach to Long Video Understanding via Continuous-Time Memory Consolidation
records.reason: Infinity-Video adds continuous-time long-term memory consolidation to video Q-formers so arbitrarily long videos can be processed training-free; the memory mechanism targets a video-understanding task rather than LLM serving.

records.title: Efficient Strong Scaling Through Burst Parallel Training
records.reason: DeepPool uses burst parallelism and GPU multiplexing to strong-scale DNN training at fixed global batch size; a training system.

records.title: TensorPrism: Rethinking Sparse High-Order Tensor Acceleration via Co-Occurrence Graph
records.reason: TensorPrism accelerates sparse high-order tensor computation via a co-occurrence graph across LLM, scientific-computing and recommender workloads; a general tensor accelerator framework, not specific to LLM inference.

records.title: MoDE: Effective Multi-task Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with a Mixture of Dyadic Experts
records.reason: MoDE shares the LoRA down-projection across tasks with rank-one dyadic experts for multi-task parameter-efficient fine-tuning on SuperNatural Instructions; a fine-tuning method.

records.title: Modulated Diffusion: Accelerating Generative Modeling with Modulated Quantization
records.reason: Modulated Diffusion accelerates diffusion-model sampling with modulated quantization and error compensation, pushing activation PTQ from 8 to 3 bits; generative diffusion inference, not LLM inference.

records.title: On Zero-Initialized Attention: Optimal Prompt and Gating Factor Estimation
records.reason: Provides optimal-estimation theory for prompts and gating factors in zero-initialized attention (LLaMA-Adapter) and its connection to mixture-of-experts; fine-tuning theory.

records.title: The Cognitive Bandwidth Bottleneck: Shifting Long-Horizon Agent from Planning with Actions to Planning with Schemas
records.reason: Compares planning with action lists versus planning with schemas for long-horizon LLM agents as action spaces scale; an agent representation study with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: SEAL: Scaling to Emphasize Attention for Long-Context Retrieval
records.reason: SEAL learns to scale retrieval-relevant attention heads to improve long-context retrieval quality and extend context limits; a capability-enhancement method, not an efficiency or serving technique.

records.title: BRIEF-Pro: Universal Context Compression with Short-to-Long Synthesis for Fast and Accurate Multi-Hop Reasoning
records.reason: BRIEF-Pro is a universal lightweight context compressor that distills retrieved documents into query-focused summaries at up to 32x compression, directly reducing RAG reader latency and context cost across model sizes.

records.title: Efficient Linear Attention for Fast and Accurate Keypoint Matching
records.reason: Linear attention with global/local attentional aggregation for sparse keypoint matching in 3D vision (SuperGlue-style matching on HPatch/ETH/Aachen); a computer-vision matching method.

records.title: DAS: Dynamic Affinity-aware Scheduling for Heterogeneous GPU Clusters
records.reason: DAS schedules generic deep-learning jobs on heterogeneous GPU clusters using multi-dimensional affinity fingerprints, cutting job completion time over 20%; cluster scheduling infrastructure not specific to LLM inference.

records.title: Adaptive Row-wise Attention Score Pruning and Compensation for Attention Acceleration
records.reason: Proposes two-stage adaptive row-wise attention score pruning plus pruning-aware softmax compensation, accelerating attention computation with higher accuracy and greater computational savings than conventional top-k prediction.

records.title: SpatialClaw: A Memory-Augmented Autonomous Ecosystem for Spatial Omics Analysis
records.reason: Title explicitly frames the work as a memory-augmented autonomous ecosystem for spatial omics analysis, a bioinformatics application domain, with no LLM inference-system subject in the title.

records.title: A Graph Prompt Fine-Tuning Method for WSN Spatio-Temporal Correlation Anomaly Detection
records.reason: Title explicitly targets spatio-temporal correlation anomaly detection in wireless sensor networks via graph prompt fine-tuning, a sensor-network application, not LLM inference systems.

records.title: Human-Like Lifelong Memory: A Neuroscience-Grounded Architecture for Infinite Interaction
records.reason: Proposes a neuroscience-grounded lifelong memory architecture for LLMs (valence vectors, System-1/System-2 retrieval escalation, thalamic gating) for infinite interaction; a conceptual memory framework whose systems implementation and evaluation are unclear.

records.title: Dual Triangle Attention: Effective Bidirectional Attention Without Positional Embeddings
records.reason: Dual Triangle Attention splits each head into past/future triangular masks to give bidirectional attention implicit positional bias, implemented as one compiled flex_attention kernel; an encoder architecture contribution whose inference-efficiency benefit is indirect.
